subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Priya Shah <priya@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to chat today. Quick recap of the usage items we discussed and a couple of clarification asks so we can produce a targeted hosted pricing estimate for FintechCo: 

Summary of what you outlined on the call:
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization & classification in your risk workflows
- Expected steady-state: ~200M tokens / month (input+output combined)
- Spikes: estimated peak TPS around 10–15 TPS during settlement windows (about 2–3 hours daily)
- Latency SLO: sub-300ms for single-turn requests is ideal, but you can tolerate occasional spikes up to ~500ms

Clarification asks to finalize the estimate: 
1) Can you confirm the 200M/mo is total tokens (prompt+response) or prompt-only?
2) For the peak TPS window, is 10–15 TPS sustained for the whole 2–3 hour window, or are those short bursts inside that window?
3) Budget target: you mentioned wanting to keep unit economics under ~$20 / 1M tokens. Is that a hard cap or a target range (e.g., $15–$20)?

Next steps from our side: we’ll produce a hosted pricing estimate and a short plan that shows cost at your projected volume, suggested rate limits to hit your latency SLO, and an initial trial scope. Attaching a quick usage template — if you can fill in the prompt/response ratio column that helps.

Would love answers to the three clarifying Qs above — if easier, we can do a 15-min follow-up tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Attachment: FintechCo_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks Ben — great summary. Quick answers below: 

1) The 200M/mo is total (prompt + response). Typical prompt is ~600 tokens, expected response ~400 tokens on average.
2) Peak TPS: the 10–15 TPS is mostly sustained for the 2–3 hour settlement window (so expect sustained load), with short micro-bursts up to ~20 TPS for a few minutes when multiple regions settle concurrently.
3) Budget: $20 / 1M tokens is the upper bound; target would be closer to $15 / 1M. Ideally we'd be at or below $20 to make the ROI work.

Happy to share logs from a pilot if helpful. We’re open to a short PoC to validate latency.

-Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing qualification: FintechCo numbers (200M/mo, sustained 10–15 TPS)

Team — forwarding Alex's answers. Key numbers: 200M total tokens / mo (600 prompt / 400 response average), sustained peak 10–15 TPS for ~2–3 hours, occasional micro-bursts to ~20 TPS. Budget cap $20 / 1M, target $15 / 1M.

Can you prepare two things for the next customer sync: 
- Marissa: a hosted pricing sheet that shows monthly cost at 200M tokens at our standard rates, discounted committed tiers, and a ~30-day trial option (include expected latency and SLA tiers). I attached the usage template — populate the prompt/response split so we can show per-call unit economics.
- Rishi: quick note on architecture / suggestions to hit sub-300ms for single-turn responses at those volumes (recommend batching settings, recommended model variants, and any prefix caching we should enable).

I attached a draft pricing doc (Redwood-hosted-pricing-v2.pdf) and the usage estimate spreadsheet. We'll aim to send a customer-facing estimate by EOD.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Attachments: Redwood-hosted-pricing-v2.pdf (pdf), FintechCo_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Priya Shah <priya@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Alex / Priya — appreciate the quick answers. Based on the inputs, here’s a customer-facing summary and next steps: 

High-level estimate (hosted API) — conservative pricing band:
- At 200M tokens / month (total), expected cost range: $3,000 — $4,000 per month at $15 / 1M to $20 / 1M (note: this is token-only charge; additional per-request or feature charges are listed in the attached PDF)
- If you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity level we can provide a blended rate that brings cost closer to $12–$14 / 1M (requires minimum monthly commit, details in attached pricing doc)
- Peak TPS: sustained 10–15 TPS can be served by a single dedicated pool with autoscale; to maintain sub-300ms we recommend model variant X-small-llama-optimized or equivalent with KV prefix caching enabled and a 50–100ms batching window for micro-burst smoothing (Rishi to provide exact infra notes).

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick PoC: 2-week hosted trial (up to 10M tokens) to validate latency and throughput.
2) PoC runbook + success metrics — we’ll share a proposed runbook (Rishi), and Marissa will finalize pricing + trial terms.
3) Follow-up: 30-min sync next Tue to review PoC results and agree on commit levels.

If that sounds good I’ll send a formal trial agreement and a populated pricing sheet.

Best,
Ben

--
Attachments: Redwood-hosted-pricing-v2.pdf (pdf)
